prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production modular pixel-art CITY UTILITY PROP PACK for an Octopath Traveler inspired HD-2D RPG. NINE individual complete objects in a generous THREE ROWS x THREE COLUMNS grid, no overlap. Top row: aged dark bronze streetlamp with unlit opaque pale amber glass; long weathered oak bench with iron legs; upright iron-hooped wooden barrel. Middle row: square wooden shipping crate with diagonal braces; low terracotta pot with dusty red flowers; taller stone pot with pale cream flowers. Bottom row: round ochre pot with muted violet flowers; small empty wooden handcart with two wheels and handles; stone town well with timber winch and small terracotta tile roof. These are separate cutout objects, NOT a composed scene. First original reference supplies the city stone/metal material identity, not its fountain silhouette; pet sheets supply pixel edge and shading compatibility only. Crisp deliberately stepped pixel edges, broad 3-4 tone clusters/material, desaturated warm limestone, weathered umber wood, dark bronze and earthy flowers. Strong Octopath Traveler tactile pixel-art feeling, sophisticated restrained saturation. Upright front billboard camera seen slightly from above24degrees, all objects face viewer with subtle visible tops. Warm upper-left subtle key/cool shadows within forms, NO ground shadows, floor, bloom, haze, text, signs, symbols, scenery or labels. Every object centered in middle55percent of its cell, large empty gutters, completely inside image, no edge touching. Exact flat solid #FF00FF key background. Objects designed to read at140-250px tall, pixel art not vector or smooth illustration.
source_card: City brief utility props. Original fountain reference establishes aged carved pale stone and town metalwork; original city map includes planting, buildings and plaza. Utility objects prescribed by Batch2; no original writing retained.
